name: Daily Delivery
summary: In the Wetlands, Daily Delivery takes cured crocolisk hides toward Menethil Harbor. Einar Stonegrip asks travelers bound for town to carry them to a local tanner.

sections.title: A Reluctant Courier
sections.body: Einar Stonegrip hunts the Wetlands, especially the aggressive crocolisks along its waterways. Their skins are valuable, but bringing them to Menethil Harbor means going home. His marriage to Sida is going through a rough patch, so Einar would rather stay in the field than face her. He gives his parcels to travelers heading toward town.

sections.title: Commerce in Menethil
sections.body: James Halloran tans hides in Menethil Harbor. Local hunters bring him leather for boots and goods suited to merchants and sailors passing through the port. Einar has been away for a week, and Halloran guesses that a quarrel with Sida explains the delivery by proxy. He wonders whether his own wife should step in and make peace with her.

faq.q: Why doesn't Einar Stonegrip deliver the skins himself?
faq.answer: Einar says his wife, Sida, has been in foul humor lately. He stays in the Wetlands and asks passing travelers to carry his deliveries into Menethil Harbor to avoid facing her temper.
James Halloran tans leather in Menethil Harbor. He buys raw pelts and hides from local trappers, cures them, then sells boots and finished leather goods.
Sida is Einar Stonegrip's wife, and she lives in Menethil Harbor. Her sour mood is why Einar stays in the marshes instead of going home.

faq.q: What kind of skins are being transported?
faq.answer: The bundle holds crocolisk skins taken from the large reptiles in the Wetlands' bogs and waterways.

faq.q: Does Halloran know why Einar is avoiding Menethil Harbor?
faq.answer: Yes. When you hand over the bundle, Halloran says Einar has not visited in nearly a week. He guesses trouble with Sida is the cause.

faq.q: Where does this delivery take place?
faq.answer: The delivery starts with Einar Stonegrip along a road in the Wetlands and ends at James Halloran's workshop in Menethil Harbor on the western coast.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you pass through Menethil Harbor, the maritime gateway between Ironforge's domain and the northern continents. Crocolisk leather helps outfit local guards and dockhands.
As a dwarf, you trade in the Wetlands' lowlands, far from Ironforge. Einar's trouble at home keeps him in the marshes, hunting crocolisks and sending travelers with his hides.
